Aaron Baptiste 107

Professional Experience  
As a Junior ML Engineer at FinTech Innovators Inc., I’ve focused on building scalable solutions for financial data. My work includes designing recommendation systems that enhance user engagement, deploying models via MLflow and AWS SageMaker, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate machine learning into core product workflows. Prior to this, I completed a 12-month internship at AlphaQuant Technologies, where I developed NLP pipelines for customer sentiment analysis using Hugging Face Transformers. This project involved refining models to handle unstructured financial data, resulting in a 15% improvement in classification accuracy. Earlier, as a Data Analyst Intern at GlobalFin Solutions, I assisted in constructing predictive models for fraud detection, leveraging Python and SQL to analyze transactional datasets and identify anomalous patterns.  

Projects  
At FinTech Innovators Inc., I contributed to a recommendation system that prioritizes user preferences by analyzing historical transaction data. The system, built with scikit-learn and deployed on AWS, reduced manual curation time by 20%. Another project involved creating a model to predict credit risk, where I used Docker to containerize the training pipeline and ensure reproducibility. This work required integrating REST APIs to fetch real-time data, which improved the model’s responsiveness. At AlphaQuant Technologies, I led the development of an NLP pipeline for customer feedback analysis. By fine-tuning BERT models on domain-specific financial text, the solution achieved a 92% accuracy rate in sentiment classification, directly impacting customer service efficiency.  

Education  
Master of Science in Data Science, University of Cambridge (2022)  
Thesis: “Leveraging Transfer Learning for Financial Text Analysis: A Case Study on Sentiment Prediction”  

Technical Skills  
AWS: Engineered scalable ML workflows using SageMaker for model deployment and managed EC2 instances for distributed training. Docker: Containerized data processing pipelines to ensure consistency across development and production environments. Hugging Face Transformers: Built and optimized NLP models for sentiment analysis, achieving measurable improvements in financial text classification. MLOps (MLflow/W&B): Instrumented model training and tracking to monitor performance metrics and facilitate collaboration with data scientists. REST API design: Integrated ML models with backend systems to enable real-time predictions. NLP: Developed solutions for financial text analysis, including named entity recognition and topic modeling. PyTorch: Implemented custom layers for deep learning tasks requiring fine-grained control over neural network architecture. TensorFlow: Utilized for prototyping and benchmarking models before deployment.
